nodes.title: Ref2VA prompt and generation canvas
widgets_values: Use the cat detective in <Picture 1> as the character reference. A continuous wide shot of a rain-soaked alley at night. The detective takes three measured steps through shallow puddles, stops under a streetlamp, and turns to look over one shoulder. The camera tracks slowly alongside. Steady rain and a soft wet footstep in sync with each paw touching the ground.

nodes.title: Running the comparison
widgets_values:
Choose your own reference in Load Image (node 7) and adjust the prompt in node 8 to match. Queue the workflow to save both clips. The branches share the reference, seed, Pika LoRA and Euler schedule.

Compare sampler times for node **13** (usual) and **113** (Sol³). The first sparse run can include Triton compilation. Warm both branches before timing repeats.

For another matched pair, increment the shared seed once and leave it fixed. For repeats with identical noise, start ComfyUI with `--cache-none` before warmup.

H3 samples 124 frames at 1280 × 736. Both outputs keep the first 120 frames, center-crop to 1280 × 720 and trim the audio to five seconds.
